verdict.rationale: Maritime's docs say each agent gets 'its own always-on micro-VM in the cloud' and that secrets are 'injected only into that agent's VM', which points to a per-agent microVM boundary. These are passing mentions in framework and config pages, not a documented isolation or security model. missing for 10: dedicated isolation/security architecture documentation (hypervisor/microVM technology, tenant separation guarantees, network/host boundary details), confirmation that the boundary applies uniformly to all workloads such as Docker agents, web apps and computers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
